title: Learning to Cook
content: Welcome to today's cooking class. We're going to make a simple pasta with tomato sauce. First, boil some water in a large pot. While waiting, chop the onions and garlic. When the water is boiling, add the pasta and cook it for about ten minutes. In another pan, heat some olive oil, add the onions and garlic, and stir for two minutes. Then add the canned tomatoes and salt. Let it simmer for fifteen minutes. Finally, drain the pasta and mix it with the sauce. Easy, right? Yes, it sounds delicious!
